risk_if_not_implemented: Without Monitoring for Indicators of Compromise (IOC), malicious, anomalous or unauthorized activity may go undetected or be detected too late to prevent or limit harm. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Delayed Containment / Increased Incident Impact (R-IR-2), Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12).

compensating_control_1.name: Monitoring For Information Disclosure
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to monitor for evidence of unauthorized exfiltration or disclosure of non-public information.
compensating_control_1.justification: Monitoring For Information Disclosure (MON-19) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Monitoring for Indicators of Compromise (IOC) (MON-17) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
compensating_control_2.description: Automated mechanisms exist to implement Data Loss Prevention (DLP) to protect sensitive information as it is stored, transmitted and processed.
compensating_control_2.justification: Data Loss Prevention (DLP) (DCH-40) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Monitoring for Indicators of Compromise (IOC) (MON-17) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
